findings.message: Docker privileged mode grants broad host capabilities.
findings.remediation: Remove privileged mode and grant only the narrowly required capabilities and devices.

findings.message: Docker host networking removes the container network namespace boundary.
findings.remediation: Use an isolated network and publish only required ports on explicit interfaces.

findings.message: Container receives a container-engine control socket; read-only filesystem mode does not prevent API commands.
findings.remediation: Remove the socket mount or use a narrowly authorized proxy with independently enforced access controls.

findings.message: Docker image uses a mutable tag or an implicit default tag rather than a digest.
findings.remediation: Pin a reviewed image digest and plan updates; tags can be reassigned. A digest does not prove publisher trust or image safety.

findings.message: npx package is not an exact registry version recognized by this audit.
findings.remediation: Pin the package to a reviewed exact version; separately verify publisher, lockfile, integrity, and updates.

findings.message: Plaintext HTTP endpoint is outside a recognized loopback address.
findings.remediation: Use HTTPS with certificate verification or a separately secured local tunnel.
